defects.title: Installed launcher misclassified installed runtime as source package
defects.evidence: Physical Windows screenshot: one_click_home_local.ps1 line 284 searched installed scripts/install_home_local.ps1.
defects.root_cause: Installed-mode auto-detection accepted only a loose marker heuristic and did not deterministically separate package layout from installed layout.
defects.fix: Package layout is detected by manifest+installer+src. Otherwise a complete installed layout enters SkipInstall automatically; incomplete layout emits HOME_LOCAL_INSTALLATION_INCOMPLETE.

defects.title: Stale shortcut could invoke PowerShell script without installed-mode arguments
defects.evidence: Physical shortcut launch entered package-install branch with empty InstalledRoot and SkipInstall.
defects.root_cause: Legacy or stale .lnk target was not verified after overwrite.
defects.fix: Installer removes and recreates the user shortcut, verifies TargetPath/WorkingDirectory/Arguments, and removes a stale common-desktop shortcut when permitted.

defects.title: START_QUANTUM.cmd passed a trailing-backslash root inside quotes
defects.root_cause: %~dp0 always ends in a backslash and relies on fragile native argument parsing.
defects.fix: CMD canonicalizes %~dp0. through FOR to a root without trailing slash and forwards optional arguments for deterministic testing.

defects.title: Partial installation produced misleading installer-not-found error
defects.evidence: Missing installed components caused fallback to package mode.
defects.root_cause: Any-marker logic could not distinguish partial install from package.
defects.fix: Required installed components are enumerated and reported without modifying config, data or output.
